In simulation, the policy reaches $1.0~\mathrm{m/s}$ on stairs with risers up to $0.20~\mathrm{m}$ and improves payload robustness up to ${\sim}15~\mathrm{kg}$ centered load and for moment-dominated wrist loads without fine-tuning. We also provide a qualitative hardware demonstration on structured terrain. Project website: https://fai-rl-tech.github.io/tact-locomotion.github.io/

</details>


### [287] [Tessellated Biomes: Distributed Robotic Assemblies for Architectural Resilience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20647)
*Sergio Mutis,Eric Hughes,Gert Duvenhage*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Tessellated Biomes框架，将微工厂制造、多材料优化和分布式机器人装配融合为循环自适应建筑系统，通过多材料模块（PLA、木材、混凝土）和四足机器人实现可重构的压缩式离散结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战传统建筑的线性生命周期，解决建筑行业在可持续性、材料循环利用和空间适应性方面的根本性缺陷，追求可重构、有韧性的建筑范式。

Method: (1) 数字制造自对齐模块化单元（PLA、木材、混凝土）; (2) 将模块聚合优化为基于压缩的离散结构; (3) 部署定制的四足机器人协作搬运和组装模块。

Result: 通过制造、优化和机器人装配的完整流程验证了框架的有效性，成功实现了离散结构的物理组装。

Conclusion: Tessellated Biomes为韧性、可重构的建筑提供了可行的模型，开创了信息物理融合的循环建筑范式。

Abstract: This paper presents Tessellated Biomes, a cyber-physical framework for the adaptive robotic construction and reconfiguration of modular multi-material assemblies. It challenges the linear lifecycle of standard construction by fusing (1) local microfactory fabrication, (2) discrete multi-material optimization, and (3) distributed robotic assembly into a unified circular process of spatial adaptation. The research details methods for the digital fabrication of self-aligning modular primitives in multiple materials (PLA, timber, and concrete) produced in local microfactories; the aggregation and optimization of these primitives into compression-based discrete structures; and the deployment of custom quadrupedal robots that collaboratively relocate material into realized physical aggregations. The framework is validated through the fabrication, optimization, and robotic assembly of discrete structures. Together, these results position Tessellated Biomes as a model for resilient, reconfigurable architecture.

</details>


### [288] [Learning Control as Enabling Layer for Embodied Intelligence Research explored with Soft Robotic Swimming in diverse Flow Speeds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20660)
*Fabian Schwab,Federico Allione,Bingcheng Wang,Mohamed El Arayshi,Claudio Mucignat,Ivan Lunati,Cristiano Verrelli,Ardian Jusufi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将PID控制与线性重复学习估计方案（PID-LRLES）相结合，以提升软体机器人在动态水流中周期波动跟踪的准确性和可重复性。实验表明，PID-LRLES相比传统PID显著降低了跟踪误差和试验间变异，为水下软体机器人的鲁棒控制提供了有效方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体机器人由于柔顺本体在变化的水动力载荷下难以精确控制，传统PID控制在静态水中有效，但在动态水流中会产生流量依赖的跟踪延迟和试验间变异性增加，亟需一种能适应动态环境流的控制方法。

Method: 在PID控制基础上引入线性重复学习估计方案（LRLES），将经典积分作用从恒定参考推广到周期性非恒定参考，采用极点负实部的稳定传递函数实现以避免经典重复控制的长期不稳定问题。在循环水流槽中于五个流速（0-32.6 cm/s）下进行闭环实验，使用嵌入式软电容弯曲传感器，控制回路频率1 kHz。

Result: PID-LRLES相比PID基线更紧密地跟踪周期弯曲包络参考，显著降低了每次试验RMSE的试验间变异（配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验，p = 1.8 × 10⁻⁴, n = 25）。嵌入式软本体感觉和周期间学习共同贡献于鲁棒性：传感器暴露周期性水动力偏差，学习项则吸收该偏差。

Conclusion: 通过减少流依赖的控制诱导变异性，该方法为未来研究形态、感知和环境流对水生 locomotion 影响的 robophysical 研究提供了使能层。

Abstract: Soft robots are valuable robophysical platforms for studying body-caudal undulatory locomotion, but their compliant bodies are difficult to control precisely under changing hydrodynamic loading. Conventional proportional-integral-derivative (PID) feedback stabilizes periodic undulation in static water, but can accumulate flow-dependent tracking delay and increasing inter-trial variability when environmental flow becomes non-trivial. Here, we evaluate whether augmenting PID control with a Linear Repetitive Learning Estimation Scheme (PID-LRLES) recovers tracking accuracy and repeatability under dynamic flow. The LRLES generalizes classical integral action from constant to periodic, non-constant references, while using a stable transfer-function realization whose poles have negative real parts to avoid the long-term instability issues of classical repetitive control. Closed-loop experiments were carried out in a recirculating flow tank at five bulk flow speeds spanning 0 to 32.6 cm s^-1, using an embedded soft capacitive bending sensor at a 1 kHz control-loop rate. With controller gains tuned once in static water and then held fixed across all conditions, PID-LRLES tracked the periodic bending-envelope reference more closely than the PID baseline and significantly reduced the inter-trial spread of the per-trial RMSE (paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p = 1.8 x 10^-4, n = 25). Embedded soft proprioception and cycle-to-cycle learning act as complementary contributors to robustness: the sensor exposes the periodic hydrodynamic bias in body deformation, while the learning term absorbs it over recent oscillation cycles. By reducing flow-dependent control-induced variability, the approach provides an enabling layer for future robophysical studies seeking to isolate the effects of morphology, sensing, and environmental flow on aquatic locomotion.

</details>


### [289] [MemoryVAM: Integrating Memory into Video Action Model for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20679)
*Yuxin Jiang,Chang Yu,Yunuo Chen,Xiang Feng,Yin Yang,Nishank Gite,Chenfanfu Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MemoryVAM通过引入基于Recap-Cue模块的 episodic memory机制，解决了视频世界模型策略在处理长程操控任务时因观测窗口短而导致的非马尔可夫性问题，在LIBERO-Mem上成功率从5%提升至42.5%，并在真实机器人任务上取得显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型策略通过预测未来观测来学习与动作相关的表征，但其仅依赖于短期观测窗口。在长程操控任务中，正确的动作往往依赖于已不可见的早期事件，这使得任务呈现非马尔可夫性，导致策略性能严重下降。

Method: 提出MemoryVAM，包含一个Recap-Cue (RC)模块：1) Recap Compressor基于Perceiver架构将每帧CLIP嵌入压缩为紧凑的记忆token；2) Cue Gate从记忆和语言中轻量估计任务完成度。记忆token注入视频骨干网络和动作解码器，使策略的"想象"与任务进度对齐。采用视频预测、delta重建辅助损失和episode边界监督进行训练，无需每帧进度标签。该方法可适配UNet和DiT骨干网络。

Result: 在LIBERO-Mem基准上，平均成功率从5%提升至42.5%。真实机器人任务中：计数任务78.3%、空间回忆80.0%、序列跟踪75.0%。

Conclusion: 提出了一种通用、高效的episodic memory机制，有效解决了视频世界模型策略在长程操控中的非马尔可夫问题，且无需额外的人工标签，可适配多种骨干网络架构。

Abstract: Video-world-model policies learn action-relevant representations by predicting future observations. However, they condition on only a short observation window, which renders long-horizon manipulation non-Markovian when the correct action depends on earlier events that are no longer visible. We present MemoryVAM, an episodic memory mechanism for video-world-model policies. We employ a Recap-Cue (RC) module, in which a Perceiver-based Recap Compressor maps per-frame CLIP embeddings into compact memory tokens, and a lightweight Cue Gate estimates task completion from memory and language. These tokens are injected into both the video backbone and the action decoder, aligning policy imagination with episode progress and conditioning actions on history. Our model trains the memory module with video prediction, a delta-reconstruction auxiliary loss, and episode-boundary supervision, requiring no per-frame progress labels. The same mechanism applies to UNet and Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbones by changing only the cross-attention injection interface. On LIBERO-Mem, our model improves average success from 5% to 42.5%. On real robots, it achieves 78.3% success on counting tasks, 80.0% on spatial recall, and 75.0% on sequential tracking. Project page: https://MemoryVAM.github.io/

</details>


### [290] [JPPD: Joint Prediction_Planning Diffusion with Differentiable Safety Guidance for Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance in Intelligent Transportation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20686)
*Jiahao Wu,Shengwen Yu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个联合预测-规划扩散框架，将参与者预测与机器人规划统一为条件轨迹生成问题，使用因果Transformer和交叉轨迹注意力从联合分布中采样所有轨迹，并引入可微安全势引导代替启发式排斥后处理，利用条件流匹配减少推理步数。实验在多种场景下验证了该方法在尾部安全性和运行效率上的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共享空间自主导航系统将轨迹预测与运动规划分解为两个独立模块，信息单向流动——预测影响规划，但规划结果无法反馈影响预测的多智能体演化，导致预测与规划之间的交互缺失。

Method: 1) 将参与者预测与机器人规划统一为条件轨迹生成问题，从单一联合分布中采样所有轨迹；2) 使用因果Transformer与跨轨迹注意力机制建模多智能体相互作用；3) 引入可微安全势引导，利用时变占用概率势的梯度直接引导联合采样器；4) 采用条件流匹配减少推理步数并保持多模态轨迹多样性。

Result: 在场景仿真、自然行人回放、Isaac Sim验证以及ROS/Orin部署实验表明，联合采样方法相比于分离的预测-规划基线方法，在尾部安全和运行效率方面均有提升。

Conclusion: 将预测与规划联合建模为统一的扩散框架，能够实现双向信息交互（规划影响预测），配合可微安全势引导，在共享空间低速自主导航中有效提升安全性和效率。

Abstract: Shared-space transportation operation requires low-speed autonomous platforms to navigate safely and efficiently among pedestrians, service robots, micromobility users, carts, and other road users. Most existing systems decompose this problem into trajectory prediction followed by motion planning, which creates one-way information flow: predicted participant futures influence the robot plan, but the selected robot plan cannot influence the predicted multi-agent evolution. This paper presents a joint prediction-planning diffusion framework that treats participant prediction and robot planning as a single conditional trajectory generation problem, where the model samples the future robot trajectory and all participant trajectories from one coupled distribution using a causal Transformer with cross-trajectory attention. To replace heuristic repulsive post-processing, the framework introduces differentiable safety potential guidance, a time-varying occupancy-probability potential whose gradient directly guides the joint sampler, and conditional flow matching is used to reduce inference steps while preserving multimodal trajectory diversity. The evaluation emphasizes shared-space operational effects, including near misses, blockage time, induced participant deviation, hard-braking events, and embedded latency, rather than treating average displacement error and final displacement error as the main result. Experiments in scenario-grounded simulation, naturalistic pedestrian replay, Isaac Sim validation, and ROS/Orin deployment show that joint sampling improves tail safety and runtime efficiency over a separated prediction-then-planning baseline.

</details>


### [291] [SafeDojo: Safe Reinforcement Learning for VLA via Interactive World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20698)
*Kai Tang,Peidong Jia,Zhong Chu,Jixian Wu,Rui Ma,Jiajun Cao,Fangyuan Zhao,Sixiang Chen,Yichen Guo,Xiaowei Chi,Chun-Kai Fan,Kevin Zhang,Jinchang Xu,Fubing Yang,Weishi Mi,Xiaozhu Ju,Jian Tang,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SafeDojo是一个基于世界模型的安全强化学习框架，通过在线强化学习与交互式视频世界模型结合，实现视觉-语言-动作策略的安全动作学习，在SafeLIBERO基准和真实Franka机器人上取得了最优的安全成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全强化学习方法要么需要昂贵的真实世界探索，要么依赖手工设计的安全函数，难以扩展到开放世界物理环境中的视觉-语言-动作模型。

Method: SafeDojo在交互式视频世界模型上进行在线强化学习，使用ResNet成功分类器估计逐步骤任务进度，轻量级安全头从潜在上下文和动作块中预测逐步骤安全成本，并通过基于拉格朗日的约束GRPO目标平衡任务奖励与安全成本。

Result: 在SafeLIBERO上，SafeDojo在任务成功率、安全成功率和执行效率上超越所有基线，Level I上比最强基线高出8.25个百分点。真实Franka部署在五个任务中取得最佳平均任务成功率和安全成功率。

Conclusion: 基于世界模型的安全强化学习是实现可扩展、可泛化的安全具身智能的有效路径。

Abstract: Safe control is a prerequisite for real-world embodied intelligence, for which safe reinforcement learning has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, existing safe reinforcement learning methods either require costly real-world exploration or depend on hand-crafted safety functions. Neither scales to vision-language-action models deployed in open-world physical environments. We propose SafeDojo, the first model-based safe reinforcement learning framework for vision-language-action policies designed to learn safe actions through world model-based imagination. Specifically, SafeDojo performs online reinforcement learning on top of an interactive video world model. The world model generates action-conditioned future predictions, from which a tailored ResNet success classifier estimates per-step task progress from imagined frames and a lightweight safety head predicts per-step safety costs from latent context together with the proposed action chunk, enabling simultaneous assessment of task execution and trajectory safety. The decoupled task-reward and safety-cost signals are balanced through a Lagrangian-based constrained GRPO objective, enabling coordinated improvement of task success and safety under explicit constraints. On SafeLIBERO, SafeDojo achieves the best aggregate task success, safe success, and execution efficiency among inference-time safety, model-free RL, and model-based RL baselines, with the best average safe-success rate on both levels and an 8.25 percentage-point improvement over the strongest baseline on Level I. Real-world Franka deployment further shows the best average task and safe-success rates across five tasks. Our results position world model-based safe reinforcement learning as a scalable and generalizable path toward safe embodied intelligence.

</details>


### [292] [Real-World Deployment of Massively Parallel Sampling-Based MPC for Contact-Rich Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20712)
*Magnus Dierking,Joao Carvalho,An Thai Le,Georgia Chalvatzaki,Jan Peters*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于JAX和MuJoCo MJX的大规模并行采样MPC框架，成功部署在Franka机器人上执行Push-T任务。其中MTP变体（结构化全局采样）在模拟和硬件上均优于CEM、MPPI等基线方法。研究还发现，在线域随机化中，接触初始化参数能提供可解释的自适应信号，而全局物理参数在典型重规划频率下反馈过弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 采样型MPC在接触丰富的机器人操作中具有潜力，但先前工作大多依赖简化动力学或局限于仿真环境，缺少真实硬件部署和系统性评估。

Method: 利用JAX进行大规模并行化计算，结合高保真MuJoCo MJX仿真器，构建MPC框架；提出MTP变体（结构化全局采样）；在Franka Research 3机器人上通过完整的real-to-sim-to-real流程执行Push-T任务。

Result: MTP变体在需要模式切换的任务中，在仿真和硬件上均优于CEM、MPPI、PS等单峰基线；接触初始化参数的在线域随机化能提供可解释的自适应信号，全局物理参数则反馈过弱。

Conclusion: 采样型MPC在接触丰富操作中面临三大挑战：接触敏感性、严格的计算预算限制、以及实时获取有效域随机化信号的困难性。

Abstract: Sampling-based Model Predictive Control (SMPC) is a promising strategy for contact-rich robotic manipulation, combining gradient-free optimization with massively parallel GPU simulation. Yet, most prior work relies on simplified dynamics or remains confined to simulation. We present an MPC framework that leverages JAX for large-scale parallelization and efficient computation, coupled with the high-fidelity MuJoCo MJX simulator, and deploy it on a Franka Research 3 executing the Push-T manipulation task through a complete real-to-sim-to-real pipeline. The MTP variant with structured global sampling outperforms unimodal baselines such as CEM, MPPI, and PS across tasks that require mode switching, both in simulation and on hardware. Furthermore, we evaluate online domain randomization within the MPC sample budget, showing that contact-initiation parameters yield interpretable adaptation signals, whereas global physics parameters provide feedback that is too weak for reliable exploitation at typical replanning frequencies. These findings highlight key challenges for sampling-based MPC in contact-rich manipulation-contact sensitivity, tight compute budgets, and the difficulty of obtaining informative domain-randomization signals in real time.

</details>


### [293] [Coupled Routing and Configuration Optimization for Multi-Viewpoint Robotic Inspection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20739)
*Minh Nhat Vu,Khang Nguyen,Vu Trung Tran,Vien Ngo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出统一框架，联合优化9自由度机器人系统的6自由度检测视角访问顺序与逆运动学配置，通过闭形式参数化、双积分器时间代理和随机密钥编码，将模块化管道从二次复杂度降为线性，实现全局时间最优路径规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模块化管道固定每个视角的单一IK配置、构建全对旅行时间图后再做路径规划，这种解耦方式导致无法实现全局时间最优，且轨迹求解复杂度为视角数的二次方。

Method: 使用闭形式参数化每个视角的三维自运动流形以保证位姿约束；用闭形式可容许双积分器代理近似静止到静止旅行时间；通过随机密钥编码顺序与配置，CMA-ES优化带罚函数的目标；对选中的路径边仅做直接配点法轨迹优化来验证动态可行性和力矩限制。

Result: 在KUKA LBR iiwa（含2自由度直线导轨）上的仿真与真实实验验证了可行性、平滑执行，相比模块化管道和基于距离的基线方法，端到端检测时间显著减少。

Conclusion: 该联合优化框架将轨迹求解从二次复杂度降为线性，消除了模块化管道的解耦问题，是实现全局时间最优检测路径的有效方法。

Abstract: We present a unified framework that turns a set of 6-DoF inspection viewpoints into a time-optimal, collision-free route for a 9-DoF robotic system. Unlike modular pipelines that fix a single inverse-kinematics (IK) configuration per viewpoint, build an all-pairs travel-time map, and then route, our method jointly optimizes the visiting order and the per-viewpoint configuration in a single global search. The three-dimensional self-motion manifold of each viewpoint is parameterized in closed form so that the pose constraint holds by construction, the rest-to-rest travel time is approximated by a closed-form admissible double-integrator surrogate, and the tour is encoded by random keys. A derivative-free optimizer (CMA-ES) minimizes a cheap penalized objective over order and configuration, after which direct-collocation trajectory optimization is applied only to the edges of the selected route to certify dynamic feasibility and torque limits, and to return exact timings. This reduces the trajectory solves from quadratic to linear in the number of viewpoints and removes the decoupling that prevents modular pipelines from being globally time-optimal. Simulations and real-robot experiments on a KUKA LBR iiwa with a 2-DoF linear stage validate feasibility, smooth execution, and reduced end-to-end inspection time relative to modular and naive distance-based baselines.

</details>


### [294] [A Digital Twin Framework for Traffic-Aware UAV Pavement Monitoring without Lane Closure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20742)
*Yamil Uchani,Grace Abigail Luna Verdueta,Mauricio Figueroa,Edwin Salcedo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Unity的数字孪生框架，用于交通感知的无人机路面检测。框架集成程序化路面缺陷生成、动态交通与行人、自主无人机导航及嵌入式检测管线（YOLOv8n检测+分类器）。在模拟器上达到99.26%准确率，并评估了三种遮挡恢复策略，其中hover-and-recheck在高中交通密度下覆盖率达97.03%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统无人机路面检测在真实道路部署时受交通、行人和临时遮挡影响严重，难以实现无需封路的实时监测。

Method: 构建Unity数字孪生环境，包含程序化缺陷生成、动态交通模拟、自主导航；感知采用YOLOv8n检测+二级分类器；评估三种遮挡恢复策略（悬停重检、微调位置、跳过重访）。

Result: 全管线在五类目标上精度99.26%；hover-and-recheck在高中密度交通下覆盖率97.03%；skip-and-revisit在低密度交通下覆盖率97.95%。

Conclusion: 数字孪生能够有效支持交通感知无人机检测策略的开发和评估，为真实部署提供可靠参考。

Abstract: UAV-based pavement inspection can reduce the cost and risk of road-surface monitoring, but real-world deployment remains difficult when traffic, pedestrians, and temporary occlusions affect the visibility of defects. This paper presents a Unity-based digital twin framework for traffic-aware UAV pavement monitoring without lane closure. The proposed environment integrates procedurally generated road defects, dynamic vehicles and pedestrians, autonomous UAV navigation, and an embedded road-damage perception pipeline. The perception module uses a two-stage approach: a lightweight YOLOv8n detector first localises road defects, pedestrians, and vehicles, while a second classifier distinguishes among potholes, single cracks, and crocodile cracks. On the simulator test set, the full pipeline achieved 99.26% overall accuracy across five classes. The digital twin was then used to evaluate three recovery strategies for occluded road segments: hover-and-recheck, micro-repositioning, and skip-and-revisit. Experiments were conducted across different traffic densities and flight altitudes using coverage, mission time, energy consumption, and revisit ratio as operational metrics. Results show that flight altitude has a strong influence on inspection coverage and that adaptive recovery improves performance under occlusion. In particular, hover-and-recheck achieved the most consistent coverage under medium and high traffic conditions, reaching up to 97.03% coverage, while skip-and-revisit was most effective in low-traffic scenarios, reaching 97.95\% coverage at medium altitude. These results demonstrate that digital twins can support the development and evaluation of traffic-aware UAV inspection strategies before real-world deployment.

</details>


### [295] [Toward Machine Risk Perception: Integrating Trust Calibration and Precursor-Based Risk Estimation for Humanoid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20748)
*He Wen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于前兆信号和信任校准的人形机器人主动风险感知框架，通过Logistic-Exponential模型建模事故演化，实现动态风险评估与人机协作安全增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于反应式力或距离限制的安全范式无法捕捉人形机器人故障的序贯性和不确定性，亟需一种能够动态感知风险、适应人类协同作业的新安全机制。

Method: 提出前兆驱动、信任校准框架；采用Logistic-Exponential（LE）耦合模型描述事故演化（Logistic用于前兆积累，Exponential用于时间衰减）；将信任定义为事故概率的倒数，实现行为自适应调整。

Result: 基于126个事件和241个前兆的多源数据集，识别出12种主要事故模式；模拟案例（“倒向人”）验证了LE-Trust耦合机制可实现早期干预并防止坍塌。

Conclusion: 人形机器人安全从静态阈值迈向动态、基于证据的推理，为工业5.0环境下风险感知与可信人机协同奠定基础。

Abstract: Humanoid robots are emerging as co-workers in smart manufacturing, yet their dynamic, human-like movements introduce safety risks that differ fundamentally from those of fixed or wheeled robots. Conventional safety paradigms based on reactive force or distance limits fail to capture the sequential, uncertain nature of humanoid failures. This study proposes a precursor-driven, trust-calibrated framework to enable proactive humanoid risk perception. Accident evolution is modeled through sequential precursor cues using a Logistic-Exponential (LE) formulation that couples logistic escalation from diverse precursors with exponential decay for temporal dissipation. Trust is defined as the inverse of the estimated accident probability, allowing humanoids to adapt behavior in real time, reducing aggressiveness when risk intensifies, and restoring confidence as stability returns. A multi-source dataset of 126 documented events and 241 precursors revealed twelve dominant accident modes, most evolving through overlapping cues within one second. A simulated case study ("fall-onto-human") demonstrated how the LE-Trust coupling can trigger early intervention and prevent collapse. The results advance humanoid safety from static thresholds toward dynamic, evidence-based inference, establishing a foundation for risk-aware and trustworthy human-robot collaboration in Industry 5.0 environments.

</details>


### [296] [Perturbation-Based Uncertainty for Failure Detection in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20754)
*Yousung Lee,Dongsoo Har*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需标签、模型无关的VLA模型不确定性估计框架，通过在推理时向Transformer隐藏激活注入高斯扰动，基于扰动预测的不一致性来检测分布偏移下的失败，在LIBERO和LIBERO-PRO上优于采样式不确定性方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代VLA模型（如基于回归或流生成的模型）无法提供显式预测概率，而现有不确定性方法依赖随机动作采样或监督失败标签，限制了其在多种预训练VLA模型上的适用性。因此需要一种无需标签、模型无关的推理时不确定性估计方法。

Method: 提出一种基于隐藏激活扰动的框架：在推理时向Transformer的隐藏激活中注入高斯噪声，从多个扰动后的动作预测中计算不一致性（如方差或分歧度），以此作为 epistemic uncertainty 的估计信号。该方法无需标签、不依赖特定模型架构。

Result: 在LIBERO和LIBERO-PRO数据集上的实验表明，基于隐藏激活扰动的估计方法在分布偏移下，相比基于随机动作采样的不确定性方法，在失败检测任务上具有一致更优的性能。

Conclusion: 该方法为VLA模型提供了一种实用、轻量级的不确定性信号，能够有效提升分布偏移下的失败检测能力，且无需额外训练数据或模型修改，具有良好的泛用性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance in robotic manipulation, but reliable uncertainty quantification remains challenging, particularly under distribution shift. Unlike autoregressive policies, many modern VLA models generate continuous actions through regression or flow-based generation, where explicit predictive probabilities are unavailable. Moreover, existing approaches often rely on stochastic action sampling or supervised failure labels, limiting their applicability across diverse pretrained VLA models. In this work, we propose a label-free and model-agnostic framework for inference-time uncertainty estimation through hidden activation perturbations, motivated by Bayesian perspectives on local model variations. Specifically, we inject Gaussian perturbations into transformer hidden activations and estimate epistemic signals from disagreement across perturbed action predictions. Experiments on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO show that perturbation-based uncertainty consistently improves failure detection under distribution shift compared to sampling-based uncertainty, providing a practical uncertainty signal for VLA models.

</details>


### [297] [UNSEEN: Uncertainty-aware Navigation via Sparse Estimation in Unknown Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20755)
*Tommaso Faraci,Marco Camurri,Daniele Fontanelli,Luigi Palopoli*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出UNSEEN框架，通过统一感知-规划耦合的视觉导航系统，仅用前视摄像头实现6Hz稀疏建图与定位，在未知环境中将轨迹估计精度提升45%，任务成功率100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉导航方法多采用松散耦合的模块化流程，忽略运动与感知的紧密耦合，且多模态传感器增加系统复杂度；感知感知方法虽部分解决该问题，但未能跨导航栈一致传播不确定性。

Method: 构建统一不确定性-感知感知导航框架，以6Hz估计稀疏地图和机器人位姿及其不确定性，在滚动时域内联合优化任务进度与估计精度的轨迹规划。

Result: UNSEEN-SLAM降低绝对平移误差9.8%，UNSEEN-Plan提升估计精度达45%，任务成功率100%。

Conclusion: 通过显式耦合定位、建图与规划，并一致传播不确定性，仅用单目前视摄像头即可在未知环境中实现鲁棒、轻量化的视觉导航。

Abstract: Visual navigation in unknown environments remains a core challenge in mobile robotics, especially for resource-constrained platforms. Most existing approaches rely on loosely coupled modular pipelines and strong assumptions on perception quality or environmental structure, often resorting to multi-modal sensor suites that increase system complexity and deployment cost. Vision-only navigation offers a lightweight alternative, but its performance degrades severely under motion blur, low texture, and illumination changes, largely because they neglect the tight coupling between commanded motion and perception. While perception-aware methods partially address this issue, they typically optimize individual modules and fail to propagate uncertainty consistently across the navigation stack. In this paper, we present UNSEEN, a unified uncertainty- and perception-aware navigation framework that explicitly couples localization, mapping, and planning using only a front-mounted camera. UNSEEN estimates sparse maps and robot poses with associated uncertainties at 6Hz, and leverages them to plan trajectories that jointly optimize task progress and estimation accuracy in receding-horizon. Simulations and extensive real-world experiments in unknown environments demonstrate the robustness of the proposed approach, with UNSEEN-SLAM reducing absolute translational error by 9.8% and UNSEEN-Plan improving estimation accuracy by up to 45% compared to state-of-the-art methods, while achieving a 100% task success rate.

</details>


### [298] [Mind the Privileged-to-Camera Gap: Actor-Centric Sidecar Supervision for Camera-First Open-Loop Waypoint Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20772)
*Feeza Khan Khanzada,Jaerock Kwon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Road-User Sidecar（RU-sidecar）方法，通过在训练时利用模拟器提供的sidecar标签（包括actor grounding、actor relevance和selected-actor motion）来监督模型学习道路使用者的表征，从而提升开环自动驾驶轨迹预测性能。该方法将终点位移误差（FDE）从1.815m降低至1.223m（降幅32.6%），在1494条路线中的1445条上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于摄像头的自动驾驶模型通常只使用未来轨迹点作为监督信号，缺乏对周围道路使用者（actors）的显式表征学习，导致模型对周边环境的理解不够充分。

Method: 提出RU-sidecar方法，在训练阶段引入模拟器导出的sidecar标签（actor grounding、privileged hindsight actor relevance、selected-actor short-horizon motion）进行监督学习，推理时仅使用多视角RGB图像、自车状态和路线命令，不依赖sidecar输入。

Result: RU-sidecar将FDE从基线1.815m降至1.223m（降幅32.6%），在1445/1494条路线上优于基线；对包含至少4个有效actor的样本FDE降低29.1%，对包含弱势道路使用者的样本降低30.0%。

Conclusion: 通过sidecar标签进行显式的actor表征监督学习能显著提升开环轨迹预测精度，但模拟器状态教师对齐存在种子方差大的问题，且仍存在特权信息到摄像头表示的能力差距。

Abstract: Camera-first autonomous-driving models predict future ego waypoints from images, ego-state features, and route commands, but waypoint supervision alone does not explicitly supervise actor-level representations of nearby road users. We study this as supervised representation learning for open-loop waypoint prediction. The deployable model uses multi-view RGB, ego state, and route command at inference. During training, simulator-derived sidecar labels supervise actor grounding, privileged hindsight actor relevance relative to the logged ego trajectory, and selected-actor short-horizon motion; these labels are never inference inputs. We evaluate route-disjoint splits with matched architecture, optimizer, validation criterion, checkpoint selection, and three seeds. A plain waypoint-only RGB baseline obtains 1.815$\pm$0.02 m final displacement error (FDE), and the matched no-teacher non-sidecar RGB control obtains 1.716$\pm$0.02 m. Road-user sidecar supervision (RU-sidecar) reduces FDE to 1.223$\pm$0.01 m, a 32.6% reduction over the plain baseline and 28.7% over the matched no-teacher non-sidecar RGB control. It improves over the plain baseline on 1445/1494 routes and over the matched no-teacher non-sidecar RGB control on 1417/1494 routes. Actor-conditioned slices show gains in all nonempty subsets, including 29.1% reduction for samples with at least four valid sidecar actors and 30.0% when a vulnerable road user is present. Optional simulator-state teacher alignment reaches 1.186$\pm$0.15 m FDE, but higher seed variability makes it secondary. Non-deployable simulator-state diagnostics remain stronger, indicating a privileged-to-camera gap. The evidence is limited to open-loop simulation diagnostics.

</details>


### [299] [World Action Models: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20781)
*Qiuhong Shen,Shihua Zhang,Yue Liao,Qi Li,Zhenxiong Tan,Shizun Wang,Shuicheng Yan,Xinchao Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文综述了世界动作模型（WAMs）领域，澄清了WAMs与视频生成、视觉-语言-动作策略等相关概念的边界，并从“生成内容类型”和“方法组件分解”两个视角系统梳理了现有工作，揭示了WAMs的设计权衡趋势：从全面生成未来转向生成更少但更关键的控制信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着WAMs领域的快速扩展，其与视频生成模型、世界模型、视觉-语言-动作策略等概念的界限日益模糊，亟需一个统一的分类框架和共同的话语体系来梳理该领域，明确不同方法的设计空间与权衡。

Method: 采用两个互补视角进行组织：(1) 按生成内容分类——渲染的未来、潜在的未来、无需视频生成的动作推理；(2) 按方法组件分解——预测基底、骨干网络、动作耦合方式、部署模式。基于此进行统一讨论，涵盖可交互性、因果性、持久性、物理合理性、泛化性等维度。

Result: 揭示了一个一致的设计模式：WAMs并非简单的“视频生成器+动作头”，而是预测动作方法，其设计选择在表示丰富性与计算、内存、延迟、动作标签成本之间进行权衡。领域趋势是“生成更少的未来，但保留控制所需的关键信息”。

Conclusion: 本文为WAMs领域建立了清晰的概念边界与系统化的分类框架，指出了未来的开放挑战（数据、评估等），并为该领域的后续研究提供了统一的参考基础。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) are embodied predictive-action models that make a forecast of the future available to action. Recent WAMs repurpose large video generation models, and a parallel line relies on language or vision-language backbones without a video-generation core. This rapid expansion has blurred the boundary among broad world models, video generation models, action-grounded video world models, Vision-Language-Action policies, and WAMs. This survey gives the field a common account. It first clarifies these boundaries, then organizes existing works through two complementary views. The first view asks what each method is required to generate, spanning rendered futures, latent futures, and video-generation-free action reasoning. The second view decomposes each method by predictive substrate, backbone, action coupling, and deployment regime. This anatomy supports a unified discussion of interactability, causality, persistence, physical plausibility, and generalization, followed by data, evaluation, and open challenges. Across these axes, a consistent design pattern emerges: WAMs are not simply video generators with action heads, but predictive-action methods whose design choices trade representational richness against compute, memory, latency, and action-label cost. The field is moving toward methods that generate less of the future while preserving what control requires. The survey homepage is available at https://world-action-models.github.io/.

</details>


### [300] [Geometric Entropy: When Trajectory Diversity Helps and Hurts in Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20871)
*Qian Luo,Ruizhe Liu,Pei Zhou,Xunzhe Zhou,Yanchao Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出几何熵（H_G）来量化演示轨迹的形状多样性，并发现IL性能与H_G呈倒U型关系：适度多样性提升鲁棒性，过度多样性导致策略模糊。最优熵随任务掌握程度提高而降低，预训练模型呈单调递减趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对轨迹形状多样性如何影响模仿学习性能的系统理解，需要一个任务无关的指标来量化这种多样性并揭示其与IL性能的关系。

Method: 提出几何熵（H_G），通过目标帧对齐归一化消除外在变化（如目标位姿、工作空间尺度），量化轨迹的内在几何多样性。在多种IL架构、模拟和真实机器人接触式操作任务上进行实验验证。

Result: 发现IL性能与H_G呈倒U型关系；最优熵随数据量增加、任务难度降低或先验增强而向低值偏移；预训练VLA模型呈现单调递减趋势。

Conclusion: H_G可作为演示数据集的快速预训练审计工具，为校准演示数据到可学习区间提供简单指导原则。

Abstract: We study how trajectory-shape diversity in demonstrations affects imitation learning (IL) performance across models, tasks, and data scales. We introduce Geometric Entropy (H_G), a task-agnostic metric that quantifies the intrinsic diversity of transit trajectories after normalizing away extrinsic variation, such as goal pose and workspace scale, via target-frame alignment. Across multiple IL architectures and both simulated and real-robot contact-rich manipulation tasks, we observe a consistent inverted-U relationship between success and H_G: increasing geometric diversity improves robustness in low-diversity regimes but degrades performance once diversity induces strategy ambiguity. Moreover, the optimal entropy shifts toward lower values as task mastery increases through more data, easier tasks, or stronger priors, and for a pretrained vision-language-action model the trend becomes effectively monotonic decreasing. Practically, H_G enables fast pre-training auditing of demonstration datasets and offers a simple guideline for calibrating demonstrations toward the learnable regime.

</details>


### [301] [Vesta: A Generalist Embodied Reasoning Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20905)
*Johan Bjorck,Zhiqi Li,Yunze Man,Jing Wang,An-Chieh Cheng,Sifei Liu,Shihao Wang,Zhiding Yu,Abhishek Badki,Stan Birchfield,Valts Blukis,Yevgen Chebotar,Siyi Chen,Sicong Leng,Yu-Cheng Chou,Tianli Ding,Boyi Li,Zhengyi Luo,Hang Su,Jonathan Tremblay,Tingwu Wang,Bowen Wen,Jimmy Wu,Xianghui Xie,Hanrong Ye,Hongxu Yin,K. R. Zentner,Liangyan Gui,Yu-Xiong Wang,Yuke Zhu,Linxi "Jim" Fan,Jan Kautz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Vesta是一个统一的具身通用模型，将定位、空间推理、导航和长时程规划整合到单一基础模型中，通过大规模语料库和简单多模态记忆机制，在多个基准上超越专业模型和集成方法，并在真实机器人任务中提升成功率超35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人系统依赖多个专业模型组合，计算成本高且容易产生级联错误，因此需要一种统一的通用模型来整合多种能力。

Method: Vesta采用单一基础模型架构，结合大规模精心设计的语料库（诱导空间理解）和简单的多模态记忆模块（支持长时间跨度的推理）。

Result: 在多个基准上，Vesta平均超越各单项最优专业模型超20%，超越集成模型超10%；在需要记忆和推理的真实机器人任务中，任务成功率提升超35%。

Conclusion: 一个统一的通用模型在可行性、可扩展性和性能上比组合多个专业模型更具优势，证明了通用模型可以匹配甚至超越专业模型。

Abstract: Robots operating in open-world environments must seamlessly integrate localization, spatial reasoning, navigation, and long-horizon planning. While specialist models excel at individual tasks, deploying a multi-model stack is computationally expensive and prone to cascading errors. We present Vesta, a unified embodied generalist that consolidates these capabilities into a single foundation model. Our approach combines a diverse and massive curated corpus designed to induce spatial grounding and a simple multimodal memory harness that enables reasoning over extended time horizons. Across diverse benchmarks, Vesta on average beats individual SOTA baselines by >$20\%$ and beats an ensemble of per-category-best baselines by $>10\%$ -- thus demonstrating that a generalist model can match or exceed specialists. On real-world robotic tasks requiring memory and reasoning, Vesta improves task success by >35\%. Our work thus demonstrates that a single generalist is a feasible, scalable, and arguably preferable alternative to combining specialists.

</details>


### [302] [Learning-Based Modeling of Soft Robots via Cosserat Rod Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20958)
*Mohammad Ali,Nithin Senthur Kumar,Eric J. Barth,Thomas Beckers*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合Cosserat杆理论和哈密顿力学的port-Hamiltonian高斯过程回归框架，用于学习和模拟平面杆状软体机器人的动力学，实现了准确且能量一致的建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体机器人动力学建模面临挑战：基于第一性原理的模型耗时且表达能力有限，而纯数据驱动模型缺乏可解释性和物理一致性。本文旨在克服这些局限。

Method: 将Cosserat杆理论与哈密顿物理学结合，融入高斯过程回归框架（port-Hamiltonian GPR），通过数据驱动推理保留系统的能量结构，同时准确学习杆的动力学行为。

Result: 数值模拟表明，该方法能够实现对杆状软体机器人准确且能量一致的表示，验证了其在复杂连续介质力学建模中的潜力。

Conclusion: 该框架为软体机器人动力学建模提供了一条稳健、可解释的路径，兼具物理一致性与数据驱动的灵活性。

Abstract: Modeling soft robot dynamics is challenging due to their continuum structure and typically nonlinear dynamics. Creating models based on first-order principles is typically time-demanding, and their expressiveness is limited, whereas data-driven models lack interpretability and physical consistency. This work aims to overcome these challenges by introducing a port-Hamiltonian Gaussian Process Regression framework for learning and simulating the dynamics of planar, rod-like soft robots. In detail, the proposed model integrates Cosserat rod theory and Hamiltonian physics with data-driven inference to preserve the system's energy structure while accurately learning the rod dynamics. Numerical simulations show that we can achieve accurate and energy-consistent representations of a rod-like soft robot, showing the potential for a robust and interpretable pathway for modeling complex continuum mechanics.

</details>


### [303] [Heterogeneous Policy Networks for Composite Robot Team Communication and Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20962)
*Esmaeil Seraj,Rohan Paleja,Luis Pimentel,Kin Man Lee,Zheyuan Wang,Daniel Martin,Matthew Sklar,John Zhang,Zahi Kakish,Matthew Gombolay*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出异构策略网络（HetNet），通过异构图注意力网络实现异构多智能体团队的高效协调与通信，在多个领域实现5.84%-707.65%的性能提升，同时将通信带宽降低200倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MARL方法难以建模异构智能体（不同状态、动作、观测空间）间的异构通信模式，同构图网络导致通信效率低下甚至损害团队性能。

Method: 基于异构图注意力网络扩展HetNet，支持端到端训练学习异构协作策略与二值化高效消息传递。

Result: 相比基线方法实现5.84%-707.65%性能提升，通信带宽降低200倍，在多个领域达到新SOTA。

Conclusion: HetNet有效解决了异构多智能体团队的协调通信问题，实现了高性能与极低通信开销的兼顾。

Abstract: High-performing human-human teams learn intelligent and efficient communication and coordination strategies to maximize their joint utility. These teams implicitly understand the different roles of heterogeneous team members and adapt their communication protocols accordingly. Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has attempted to develop computational methods for synthesizing such joint coordination-communication strategies, but emulating heterogeneous communication patterns across agents with different state, action, and observation spaces has remained a challenge. Without properly modeling agent heterogeneity, as in prior MARL work that leverages homogeneous graph networks, communication becomes less helpful and can even deteriorate the team's performance. In the past, we proposed Heterogeneous Policy Networks (HetNet) to learn efficient and diverse communication models for coordinating cooperative heterogeneous teams. In this extended work, we extend Heterogeneous Policy Networks (HetNet) to support scaling heterogeneous robot teams. Building on heterogeneous graph-attention networks, we show that HetNet not only facilitates learning heterogeneous collaborative policies but also enables end-to-end training for learning highly efficient binarized messaging. Our empirical evaluation shows that HetNet sets a new state of the art in learning coordination and communication strategies for heterogeneous multi-agent teams by achieving an 5.84% to 707.65% performance improvement over the next-best baseline across multiple domains while simultaneously achieving a 200x reduction in the required communication bandwidth.

</details>


### [304] [Duet: Dual-Robot Understanding via Efficient Teaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20990)
*Yiqi Zhao,Ruohai Ge,Celina Shiyu Wang,Junjie Ye,Muchen Xu,Minhao Li,Sergey Zakharov,Basile Van Hoorick,Vitor Campagnolo Guizilini,Leonidas Guibas,Gaurav S. Sukhatme,Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出DUET框架，通过VR遥操作和人类协作先验来高效收集双机器人数据，结合Action Chunking Transformer预训练与微调，实现优于纯机器人数据训练策略的双机协作移动操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双机器人协作能完成超越单机器人的任务，但数据采集是主要瓶颈，现有方法数据效率低下，需要大量人工遥操作。

Method: 1) 构建统一的双体态同步VR遥操作系统收集异构机器人数据；2) 开发人体协作追踪管道记录人类协作先验；3) 基于Action Chunking Transformer，先在人类示范数据上预训练协作策略，再在少量真实机器人轨迹上微调。

Result: 在四项协作任务中，利用人类先验的方法性能优于纯机器人数据基线，且人类数据采集速度平均提升5.4倍，任务表现持平或更优。

Conclusion: 人类协作先验能有效减少双机器人协作学习所需的人工数据采集成本，同时提升任务性能，为数据高效的双机器人学习提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Dual-robot collaboration enables tasks that exceed the reach and payload of a single robot, such as collaboratively transporting objects across environments and executing coordinated handovers. Data acquisition is the primary bottleneck for training these systems. To this end, we introduce DUET, a dual-robot learning framework for mobile manipulation. For efficient data collection, we create a unified dual-embodiment synchronized VR-based teleoperation system for in-domain heterogeneous robot data collection. We further develop a complementary tracking pipeline that records human-human coordination and collaborative mobile manipulation priors. To allow efficient learning, we introduce an Action Chunking Transformer based architecture that first pretrains collaborative policies on efficient human-human demonstrations, before finetuning them on a minimal set of real-robot teleoperation trajectories. We develop a benchmark of four collaborative tasks to evaluate our framework using a Unitree G1 humanoid and a Dexmate Vega1 mobile manipulator. The results demonstrate that harnessing human priors not only yields superior task performance compared to baselines trained only on robot data, but also reduces the total human effort required for data collection. Our human data collection pipeline achieves 5.4x acceleration on average from teleoperation, but we perform equally or better than robot-only data trained policies across all tasks. Our project page is available at https://zhaoy37.github.io/Duet/.

</details>


### [305] [Inductive Generalization for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20999)
*Annabella Macaluso,Haochen Zhang,Ishaan Masilamony,Yingshan Chang,Yonatan Bisk*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"归纳泛化"概念，用于评估视觉运动策略在分布外任务变体上的泛化能力，并证明现有方法（包括SOTA视觉-语言-动作模型）在此测试中失败，揭示了与数据和模型扩展正交的学习挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉运动策略的泛化评估多依赖于已知分布上的非结构化域偏移（如光照、杂乱场景），无法真正衡量策略的归纳能力。作者希望建立更严格的评估方法，以揭示模型在面对分布外任务变体时的真实泛化局限。

Method: 借鉴语言模型中基于轴的评估方式（如序列长度、计数），提出"归纳泛化"评估协议，在操作策略上系统性地测试模型在难度递增、分布外任务变体上的归纳能力，并建立基线比较现有范式。

Result: 现有策略（包括SOTA视觉-语言-动作模型）在归纳泛化测试中均失败；那些在传统域偏移（如干扰物）上表现良好的策略，在归纳泛化测试中无法通过。

Conclusion: 归纳泛化揭示了一类与数据/模型缩放正交的学习挑战，是通往通用机器人的关键瓶颈，必须加以解决。

Abstract: Understanding the generalization capabilities of visuomotor policies is essential in the development of capable robotic agents. Generalizable models learn structures that transfer across domains. However, in practice, visuomotor policies test performance by interpolation on known distributions using unstructured domain shifts (e.g. lighting, clutter, diverse objects). We argue that to measure generalization capabilities we must instead test the inductive capacity of policies on progressively harder, out-of-distribution task variants. We call this inductive generalization, drawing directly on how axis-based evaluation has revealed inherent generalization limitations in language models (e.g. sequence length, counting) arXiv:2502.00197 . We provide a reusable and formal evaluation protocol for measuring inductive generalization in any manipulation policy, and establish baselines showing that existing paradigms fail this test; e.g. SoTA Vision-Language-Action models and find that policies that appear to generalize to prior domain shifts (distractors, etc) fail inductive generalization tests. These results expose a class of learning challenges orthogonal to those addressed by data and model scaling in robot learning, yet are imperative to solve in order to realize general purpose robots.

</details>


### [306] [R2HandoverSim: A Simulation Framework and Benchmark for Robot-to-Human Object Handovers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21011)
*Hanxin Zhang,Abdulqader Dhafer,Hongbiao Dong,Zhou Daniel Hao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出R2HandoverSim，一个机器人对人物体交接的仿真基准，通过标准化评估协议、四个基线比较、30人用户研究，证明仿真结果与真实世界评估相关，并指出五类互补指标比单一成功率更能反映用户感知的交接质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人对人物体交接方法发展迅速，但缺乏标准化评估协议，导致方法间难以进行客观比较。

Method: 构建仿真基准R2HandoverSim，系统比较四种基线方法在预测共享抓取位姿上的表现，开展30人用户研究，提出五类互补评估指标。

Result: 仿真结果与真实世界评估结果相关；五类互补指标（规划可行性、可达性、抓取稳定性、抓取适用性、安全性）比单一成功率更能反映用户感知的交接质量。

Conclusion: R2HandoverSim可作为标准化评估工具，推动机器人对人物体交接领域的客观比较与可复现研究。

Abstract: We present R2HandoverSim, a simulation benchmark for robot-to-human (R2H) object handovers. Although R2H handover methods have advanced rapidly, the lack of standardized evaluation protocols impedes objective comparison. Our benchmark enables reproducible evaluation by systematically comparing four baselines on their predicted shared grasp poses. We conduct a user study with 30 participants, analyze baseline performance, and show that simulation results correlate with real-world evaluation outcomes. Crucially, five complementary metrics (planning feasibility, reachability, grasp stability, grasp affordance, and safety) better reflect user-perceived handover quality than overall success rate alone. Website and code: https://robot-future.github.io/r2handoversim/.

</details>


### [307] [BayesFP: Posterior Estimation for Flow-Based Policies via Feynman-Kac Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21014)
*Sreevardhan Sirigiri,Weiming Zhi,Fabio Ramos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Feynman-Kac校正框架的推理时约束轨迹生成方法，无需重训练即可对预训练的扩散策略和流匹配策略进行贝叶斯后验采样，在模拟和真实机器人操作任务中提升了安全约束下的轨迹质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人轨迹生成需要同时满足三点：忠实于专家演示行为、满足安全约束、完成推理时才指定的任务目标。现有预训练策略难以灵活融入推理时的约束和目标。

Method: 将约束轨迹生成建模为贝叶斯后验采样：以学到的演示分布为先验，以推理时成本函数导出的似然项倾斜先验分布。利用Feynman-Kac校正框架（原用于扩散模型）采样后验，并将其扩展到确定性流匹配策略，形成统一的、无需重训练的推理时采样器。

Result: 在Diffusion Policy、GR00T-N1.6、π₀.₅等预训练模型上验证，涵盖仿真和真实操作任务（包括推理时引入的非凸障碍物规划），并在零样本任务上优于基线π₀.₅。

Conclusion: 提出的方法有效地将推理时的约束和目标融入预训练扩散/流策略中，无需额外训练，在安全性和任务性能上均有提升。

Abstract: Robots must generate trajectories that remain faithful to learned expert behavior while satisfying safety constraints and task-specific objectives specified only at inference time. We formulate constrained trajectory generation for pretrained diffusion and flow-matching policies as Bayesian posterior sampling, with the learned demonstration distribution as a prior and an inference-time, cost-derived likelihood tilting it toward feasible, optimal trajectories. To sample from this posterior without any retraining of the base policy, we leverage the Feynman--Kac corrector framework, originally formulated for diffusion models, and extend it to deterministic flow-matching policies. The result is a unified, inference-time, retraining-free sampler for diffusion and flow policies. We validate the approach on pretrained Diffusion Policy, GR00T-N1.6, and $π_{0.5}$ checkpoints across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, including planning around non-convex obstacles introduced at inference time, and show improvements over the base $π_{0.5}$ on zero-shot tasks.

</details>


### [308] [Membrane-based Acoustic Microrobots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21047)
*Fatih Kocabas,Cemal Polat Avdar,Prithvi Venkatesh,Yunus Alapan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于柔性PDMS薄膜密封微腔的声学微型机器人，解决了传统气泡型声学微机器人因气体溶解导致寿命短、共振频率漂移的问题。该设计可实现超过24小时的稳定微流推进，并可通过嵌入磁性微粒实现外部磁场定向控制，且可缩小至约100微米尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统声学微型机器人依赖被困在微腔中的空气气泡产生微流，但气泡会迅速溶解，导致共振频率变化和操作寿命有限，亟需一种能长期稳定工作的方案。

Method: 在微型机器人的微腔上方键合一层柔性PDMS薄膜，物理上防止气体扩散；同时在结构体中嵌入磁性微粒，实现低强度磁场（2 mT）下的方向控制。

Result: 膜基声学致动器可连续稳定工作超过24小时；在2 mT弱磁场下可实现定向推进控制；展示了可扩展至约100微米尺寸的能力。

Conclusion: 该膜基方法为开发高耐久性声学微致动器和微机器人提供了可靠框架，使其能够胜任长期任务。

Abstract: Acoustic microrobots have emerged as a promising frontier for targeted drug delivery and minimally invasive medicine due to their high-power density and biocompatibility. Despite wide-ranging designs, conventional acoustic microrobots mostly rely on air microbubbles trapped within confined microcavities within the robot body, which suffer from limited operational longevity due to rapid gas dissolution and resultant shifts in resonance frequency. In this paper, we propose a robust, membrane-based acoustic microrobot that overcomes these limitations by employing a thin flexible Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) membrane bonded over confined microcavities for microstreaming. The introduced design physically prevents gas diffusion, ensuring stable performance over extended periods at high actuation voltages. We systematically characterized the membrane-based acoustic actuator longevity, demonstrating consistent streaming and propulsion for over 24 hours of continuous operation. In addition, by embedding magnetic microparticles into the structural body, these actuators were successfully employed as microswimmers with directional control using low-intensity (2 mT) external magnetic fields. Finally, we demonstrate the scalability of the proposed design architecture down to ~100 um. This membrane-based approach establishes a reliable framework for the development of high-endurance acoustic microactuators and microrobots capable of performing long-term tasks.

</details>


### [309] [ReFPO: Reflow Regularization for Flow Matching Policy Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21086)
*Ge Wang,Yibo Peng,Fan Feng,Shenhao Yan,Chengsi Yao,Jiahao Yang,Honghao Cai,Yiming Zhao,Xi Li,Jinke Ren,Shuguang Cui,Yatong Han,Zhen Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ReFPO是一种简单高效的在线强化学习方法，通过引入显式Reflow正则化项（仅需修改一行代码）来稳定流匹配策略梯度训练，实现单步推理即可媲美多步性能，在多种物理控制任务中提升了平均性能和离散化鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Flow Matching Policy Gradients (FPO) 方法存在CFM代理比率尖峰、PPO训练不稳定等问题，且多步推理效率低。作者希望探索一种更稳定、高效且无需额外计算开销的流式控制策略优化方法。

Method: ReFPO在FPO基础上引入显式Reflow几何正则化项；关键发现是FPO的梯度更新可被解释为隐式的优势加权Reflow过程，基于此洞察添加显式正则化；仅需一行代码改动，无需额外计算开销或辅助蒸馏阶段；将优势引导更新与路径整流（path rectification）协同作用。

Result: 在GridWorld、MuJoCo Playground和高维Humanoid Control任务上，ReFPO相比基线方法提升了平均性能；减少了CFM代理比率尖峰，稳定了PPO风格训练；实现了高质量的单步推理，性能往往达到或超过多步推理效果；提升了离散化鲁棒性。

Conclusion: ReFPO提供了一种可扩展且稳定的生成式策略方法，适用于复杂物理仿真环境，为流式策略梯度训练提供了新的几何视角和实用改进方案。

Abstract: We present Reflow-regularized Flow Matching Policy Gradients (ReFPO), a simple online RL method that adds explicit Reflow regularization to FPO for efficient flow-based control. We uncover a key structural property: the gradient updates in Flow Matching Policy Gradients (FPO) can be interpreted as an implicit advantage-weighted Reflow process, providing a new geometric perspective on flow-based policy gradients. Building on this insight, ReFPO introduces an explicit geometric regularizer that can be implemented with a single line of code change without incurring additional computational overhead or auxiliary distillation stages. By synergizing advantage-guided updates with path rectification, our method reduces CFM proxy-ratio spikes, stabilizes PPO-style training, and enables high-fidelity one-step inference that often matches or exceeds multi-step performance. We experimentally demonstrate that ReFPO improves average performance and discretization robustness across GridWorld, MuJoCo Playground, and high-dimensional Humanoid Control tasks, providing a scalable and stable approach for generative policies in complex physical simulations.

</details>


### [310] [MV-WAM: Manifold-Aware World Action Model with Value Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21088)
*Jintao Chen,Peidong Jia,Qingpo Wuwu,Jiaming Liu,Mengfei Du,Chun-Kai Fan,Xiaowei Chi,Hao Chen,Chengyu Bai,Zezhong Qian,Hao Wang,Jiajun Cao,Weishi Mi,Xiaozhu Ju,Jian Tang,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MV-WAM框架，通过跨模态因果掩码、流形感知优化和进度-价值调节机制，解决了机器人操作中视觉与动作模态的结构性不匹配问题，在仿真和真实世界任务中显著提升了策略的泛化鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型在域内表现良好，但在分布外场景下泛化能力不足。作者认为这是由于视觉与动作模态之间存在结构性的流形不匹配，导致联合优化在分布偏移下会不成比例地损害动作的鲁棒性。

Method: 提出MV-WAM端到端框架，包含三个核心组件：1）跨模态因果掩码，将动作层次化地基于预测视频帧和价值函数；2）流形感知优化方案，显式处理模态间的结构异质性；3）进度-价值调节机制，检测预测帧与生成动作之间的错位，并通过价值引导回滚实现自主恢复。

Result: 在RoboTwin仿真中，随机场景平均成功率55.7%，超过最强基线29.3%；在双机械臂四个真实世界任务中平均成功率达77.5%。

Conclusion: 流形感知的跨模态对齐对于鲁棒策略泛化至关重要，为实现可部署的机器人操作提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Achieving robust and generalizable manipulation across diverse environments remains a fundamental challenge in embodied robotics. Recent world action models achieve strong in-domain performance, yet their gains do not extend proportionally to out-of-distribution scenarios. We attribute this to a structural mismatch between visual and action modalities, whose intrinsically heterogeneous manifolds cause joint optimization to disproportionately degrade action robustness under distribution shift. To address this, we propose MV-WAM, a novel end-to-end framework that jointly models visual prediction, action generation, and value estimation designed to effectively leverage video priors during both training and inference for enhanced action generalization. Key to this unification is a cross-modality causal mask that hierarchically grounds actions in predicted video frames and value function tokens in both modalities. To further narrow the generalization gap, MV-WAM adopts a manifold-aware optimization scheme that explicitly accounts for the structural heterogeneity across modalities. Finally, MV-WAM introduces a progress-value regulation mechanism that estimates task completion and detects misalignment between predicted frames and generated actions, enabling the policy to autonomously identify execution deviations and recover through value-guided rollback. On the RoboTwin simulation, MV-WAM achieves a 55.7% mean success rate on random scenarios without any randomized action supervision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 29.3%. MV-WAM achieves a 77.5% mean success rate across four real-world tasks of varying difficulty on a dual-arm robot. Our results demonstrate that manifold-aware cross-modal alignment is essential for robust policy generalization, offering a path toward deployable robotic manipulation.

</details>


### [311] [How Should a Robot Configure Its Laser Scanner for Inspection?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21093)
*Zhiling Chen,David Gorsich,Matthew P. Castanier,Yang Zhang,Jiong Tang,Farhad Imani*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SenseHD是一个机器人传感系统，将扫描仪配置转化为指令驱动的传感决策，通过超维联想记忆选择稳定传感模式，在实际检测平台上显著提升了检测可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人检测工作主要关注运动与视点规划，而传感参数配置对测量质量有决定性影响，但该问题尚未被充分探索。

Method: 将传感参数配置建模为指令条件化的传感决策问题，将传感参数视为离散传感动作，通过超维联想记忆选择稳定的传感状态。

Result: 在真实机器人检测平台上，SenseHD能够鲁棒地选择合适的传感配置，显著提升检测可靠性，同时相比基线方法更轻量高效。

Conclusion: 通过超维联想记忆的离散化传感参数选择策略，可以有效提升机器人检测系统的可靠性，且计算开销低，适合实际部署。

Abstract: Robotic inspection relies on accurate sensing to acquire high-fidelity geometric measurements for defect detection and metrology. While prior work has focused on robot motion and viewpoint planning, how to configure sensing parameters remains largely underexplored, despite their decisive impact on measurement quality. We propose SenseHD, a robotic sensing system that formulates scanner configuration as an instruction-conditioned sensing decision. Instead of predicting precise parameter values, SenseHD treats sensing parameters as discrete sensing actions and selects stable sensing regimes through hyperdimensional associative memory. Experiments on a real robotic inspection platform demonstrate that SenseHD robustly selects appropriate sensing configurations and significantly improves inspection reliability, while remaining lightweight and efficient compared to baseline methods.

</details>


### [312] [Factor-Aware Mixture-of-Experts with Pretrained Encoder for Combinatorial Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21100)
*Feihong Zhang,Guojian Zhan,Zeyu He,Yinuo Wang,Likun Wang,Tianze Zhu,Yao Lyu,Tao Zhang,Tinghao Yi,Wei You,Shengbo Eben Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FAME是一个结合因子感知混合专家模型与预训练编码器的框架，通过三阶段训练（策略预热、因子适配器训练、联合微调）提升视觉机器人操作在光照、表面纹理等环境变化下的泛化能力，在Meta-World基准测试中比扩散策略基线提升34%，真实拾取任务中提升35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的预训练编码器+扩散策略范式在复杂环境（如光照变化、表面纹理差异）中泛化能力不足，难以应对多因子共同变化的环境。

Method: 三阶段训练：1) 策略预热——在标准环境数据上训练扩散策略（编码器冻结）；2) 因子适配器训练——在编码器与冻结策略间插入轻量适配器，每个适配器针对单一环境变化因子训练；3) 联合微调——中心路由器与策略在混合数据上训练，路由器对冻结的因子适配器进行软加权，形成密集MoE实现组合泛化。

Result: 在Meta-World基准测试中，FAME相比扩散策略基线提升34%；在真实世界的拾取任务中，使用新收集数据训练的紧凑模型取得35%的泛化提升。

Conclusion: 因子感知的混合专家架构能够有效解耦并组合多个环境变化因子，显著提升视觉机器人操作策略的泛化能力，在仿真和真实环境中均有效。

Abstract: The integration of pretrained encoders with diffusion policies has become a dominant paradigm for visual robotic manipulation. However, it still struggles to generalize across complex environments with varying factors such as lighting and surface textures. To address this, we propose FAME, a framework that integrates a factor-aware mixture-of-experts (MoE) with a pretrained encoder to enhance generalization to environmental variations. FAME follows a three-stage training process: (1) policy warmup, where a diffusion policy is trained on standard-environment data with a frozen encoder; (2) factor-specific adapter training, where lightweight adapters inserted between the frozen encoder and the temporarily frozen policy are trained on customized datasets, each targeting a distinct environmental variation; and (3) joint fine-tuning, where a central router and the warmed policy are trained on mixed data to handle multiple factors jointly. FAME is ``factor-aware'' because the central router softly weights frozen factor-specific adapters as a dense MoE, enabling combinatorial generalization across multiple factors. Evaluations on the Meta-World benchmark show that FAME outperforms diffusion policy baselines by 34%. We further validate FAME in a real-world pick-and-place task using a compact model trained on newly collected data, where FAME achieves a 35% improvement in generalization under real-world variations.

</details>


### [313] [PoLAR: Factorizing Extent and Mode in Latent Actions for Robot Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21139)
*Youngjoon Jeong,Jihwan Yu,Minsoo Jo,Junha Chun,Taesup Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PoLAR是一种在潜在动作空间中引入径向-方向结构的方法，通过双曲空间让半径编码转变程度、方向编码转变模式，提升了机器人策略学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在动作预训练方法将每个转变编码为单一非结构化表示，混淆了转变程度和转变模式，希望将这两种信息解耦以改进表示学习。

Method: 提出PoLAR，在潜在动作空间中施加径向-方向结构：半径编码转变程度（利用时间偏移作为弱代理），方向编码转变模式；并在双曲空间中实例化这一结构，利用其随半径扩大的体积容纳更多样的转变模式。

Result: 在任务内和大规模预训练设置中，PoLAR在下游策略性能上优于潜在动作基线和强预训练VLA基线，在仿真和真实机器人实验中均有效。

Conclusion: 潜在动作空间的几何结构是影响视觉预训练迁移到下游机器人策略学习的重要设计选择。

Abstract: Latent action pretraining learns representations of visual change from pairs of observations, but existing methods typically encode each transition as a single unstructured representation that entangles transition extent and transition mode. We introduce Polar Latent Actions with Radial structure (PoLAR), which imposes a radial-direction structure on latent actions, encouraging radius to encode transition extent and direction to retain transition mode. PoLAR uses temporal offset between two observations as a weak proxy for transition extent, encouraging latent action from observation pairs separated by larger temporal gaps to occupy larger radii. We instantiate this structure in hyperbolic space, whose expanding volume with radius offers a natural fit for more diverse transition modes at larger extents. Across in-task and large-scale pretraining settings, PoLAR improves downstream policy performance in simulation and real-world robot experiments, outperforming latent action baselines and strong pretrained VLAs. These results suggest that the geometry of the latent action space is an important design choice for transferring visual pretraining to downstream robot policy learning.

</details>


### [314] [Pose-Agnostic Robotic Functional Grasping via Observation-Action Canonicalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21148)
*Le Qiu,Cole Harrison,Jiankai Sun,Yao Liu,Suning Huang,Qianzhong Chen,Yang You,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AnyMug提出了一种基于规范化的视觉-运动强化学习框架，通过观测-动作规范化（将深度观测和末端执行器动作映射到物体中心坐标系）实现零样本从仿真迁移到真实机器人，在杯柄抓取任务中达到80%以上的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 功能性机器人抓取需要泛化到不同物体几何形状和姿态，但现有方法（抓取姿态检测开环控制对细薄手柄估计敏感；端到端策略难以处理视觉外观与动作方向的耦合变化）在处理杯柄抓取等精细任务时泛化能力有限。

Method: 提出AnyMug框架：(1) 观测-动作规范化（Observation-Action Canonicalization），将深度观测和预测的末端执行器动作变换到物体中心坐标系；(2) 手柄感知奖励函数（Handle-aware Reward），鼓励精确接近、夹爪对齐和对向手指放置；(3) 姿态课程学习（Pose Curriculum）和域随机化（Domain Randomization）提升训练稳定性和仿真到真实迁移。

Result: 仿真中，AnyMug对未见过的正放和倒放杯子成功率超过93%；零样本迁移到真实Franka Panda机器人，在5个真实杯子上正放和倒放两类姿态下达到80%成功率。

Conclusion: AnyMug通过规范化策略有效解耦了物体姿态变化对视觉观测和动作方向的影响，使得在仿真中学到的单一闭环策略能够零样本迁移到真实机器人上完成功能性杯柄抓取。

Abstract: Functional robotic grasping requires a policy that generalizes across diverse object geometries and poses while maintaining task-specific contact precision. We study this challenge through mug-handle grasping, where thin handles, instance variation, and upright or inverted placements make both perception and control sensitive to object configuration. Grasp pose detection methods operate open-loop and are sensitive to estimation errors on thin handle structures. Learned visuomotor policies must implicitly learn to handle the coupled variation in visual appearance and action direction induced by different object placements, limiting generalization. We propose AnyMug, a canonicalized visuomotor reinforcement learning framework for functional grasping that trains a single closed-loop policy entirely in simulation and deploys it zero-shot on a real robot. AnyMug introduces observation-action canonicalization, which transforms both the depth observation and the predicted end-effector action into a shared object-centric frame. The policy therefore sees a consistent mug-centered view and emits actions in a canonical direction regardless of mug placement, allowing the same grasping behavior to be reused across configurations. A handle-aware reward further encourages precise approach, gripper alignment, and opposing-finger placement, while a pose curriculum and domain randomization improve training stability and sim-to-real transfer. In simulation, AnyMug achieves over 93% success rate on both unseen upright and inverted mugs and transfers zero-shot to a real Franka Panda, reaching 80% success rate on 5 held-out physical mugs across both pose categories.

</details>


### [315] [OmniV2X: A Generative Foundation Planner for Efficient End-to-End Cooperative Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21165)
*Juntong Peng,Juanwu Lu,Yupeng Zhou,Can Cui,Yaobin Chen,Ziran Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OmniV2X是一种面向V2X协同驾驶的生成式基础模型，通过序列建模和交叉注意力机制，以极低的数据和带宽需求实现了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法存在三大问题：密集3D感知计算成本高、协同场景数据稀缺、多模态融合时与标准化消息不兼容。OmniV2X旨在克服这些局限。

Method: 提出生成式序列规划器，直接处理多模态多智能体上下文序列，采用端到端监督训练（下游轨迹生成损失），通过交叉注意力注入融合多模态输入，并利用轻量级标准化V2X令牌适配协同环境。

Result: 在DAIR-V2X-Seq数据集上，仅用不到10%的微调数据和不到1%的通信带宽，即超越现有端到端协同驾驶基线，达到SOTA。

Conclusion: OmniV2X验证了生成式基础模型在V2X协同驾驶中的有效性，兼具计算效率、数据高效性和鲁棒性，符合实际部署需求。

Abstract: We present OmniV2X, a generative foundation model for vehicle-to-everything (V2X) cooperative driving. The model directly interprets independent context sequences comprising multi-modal and multi-agent observations. The new design mitigates the computational cost of dense 3D perception, the vulnerability to data scarcity in cooperative scenarios, and the poor compliance with standardized messaging in existing methods that fuse multi-modal inputs into a shared representation. For training, we present an end-to-end supervised pipeline using a downstream trajectory generation loss, in which a high-capacity generative sequence planner implicitly learns to steer the model and leverage multi-modal inputs via cross-attention injection. As a foundation model, we demonstrate that OmniV2X pre-trained on large-scale single-agent planning datasets can efficiently adapt to cooperative environments by integrating the conditioning context with lightweight, standard-compliant V2X tokens. Evaluated on the DAIR-V2X-Seq dataset, OmniV2X outperforms existing end-to-end cooperative driving baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance with less than 10% of the fine-tune V2X dataset and less than 1% of the communication bandwidth. We conduct comprehensive evaluations to demonstrate its computational efficiency and robustness under real-world constraints.

</details>


### [316] [Remember what you did?: Learning Behavioral Memories for Partially Observable Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21188)
*Kuancheng Wang,Seungho Yeom,Jinglin Cao,Yuheng Zhi,Nikhil Shinde,Michael Yip*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出压缩动作记忆策略（CAMP），利用机器人自身动作历史作为自监督信号，训练记忆模块压缩过去动作信息以编码潜在行为记忆，从而解决长时程、接触密集操作任务中的部分可观测性问题。在四个真实机器人平台和两个新仿真基准上，CAMP显著优于现有方法，是首个仅通过学习记忆就能在此类任务中取得显著成功的策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程、接触密集的操作任务具有固有的部分可观测性，单一视觉观测无法捕捉机器人的完整动作上下文（如先前尝试、交互过程或任务进度）。标准视动策略或视觉-语言-动作模型因缺乏记忆机制而在这类任务中表现不佳。

Method: CAMP基于"机器人自身动作历史是高度信息量的自监督信号"这一洞察，训练一个记忆模块维护过去动作的压缩表示，强制其编码所有过去交互的潜在行为记忆，从而为未来动作提供更好的上下文。该方法无需额外监督或外部干预，可隐式追踪任务进度并从未成功尝试中学习。

Result: 在四个真实机器人平台和两个新仿真基准（Memory-T-Bench和Memory-Manip-Bench）上，CAMP显著优于最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: CAMP是首个仅通过学习记忆就在接触密集部分可观测操作任务中取得显著成功的策略，证明了动作历史压缩记忆的有效性。

Abstract: Long horizon, contact-rich manipulation is inherently partially observable. This is as a single visual observation rarely captures a robot's full action context, including prior attempts, interactions, or progress. Consequently, standard visuomotor policies or vision-language-action models are prone to struggle in such tasks due to a lack of memory. To address this, we introduce Compressed Action Memory Policy (CAMP) based on the insight that a robot's own action history serves as a highly informative, self-supervised signal, enabling the policy to learn a robust, compact history representation. In our approach, we train a memory module to maintain a compressed representation of past actions, forcing it to encode a latent behavioral memory of all the robot's past interactions that can then be used to better contextualize future actions. This allows our approach to implicitly track generalized task progress and learn from failed attempts without any additional supervision, or external oversight. We evaluate CAMP across four real-robot setups and two novel simulation benchmarks: Memory-T-Bench and Memory-Manip-Bench. By demonstrating substantial gains over state-of-the-art baselines, CAMP is, to our knowledge, the first policy to demonstrate substantial success on contact-rich partially observable manipulation tasks purely through learned memory.

</details>


### [317] [A scalar per patch from pre-trained ViTs enables fast moving navigation in the real world](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21216)
*Steeven Janny,Leonid Antsfeld,Christian Wolf*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文通过966次真实世界导航实验（24公里），系统评估了视觉编码器在机器人导航中的关键作用，发现预训练辅助任务、多教师蒸馏、特征瓶颈化及特权信息微调等因素对性能有显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究指出视觉编码器的性能不仅来自机器人下游损失训练，预训练辅助任务也至关重要，但缺乏大规模真实世界的系统实证研究。

Method: 在真实建筑中执行966次静态点目标导航（共24公里），系统性地对比不同视觉编码器、多教师蒸馏策略、特征瓶颈化方法以及基于特权信息的微调效果。

Result: 1）预训练辅助任务是性能的决定性因素；2）多教师蒸馏可融合互补技能；3）合理的特征瓶颈化能产生与可通行性相关的可解释特征；4）仅用RGB数据训练策略并非最优，基于特权信息微调可提升性能。

Conclusion: 本研究描绘了计算机视觉对真实世界导航影响的完整图景，揭示了哪些视觉组件真正重要，为机器人视觉系统的设计提供了大规模实验依据。

Abstract: Trained policies for real-world robotics rely on computer vision components, typically in the form of pre-trained visual encoders. These encoders are an essential component and it has been shown that their power does not emerge from training on robotics downstream losses alone. Pre-training with auxiliary losses in the form of computer-vision pre-text tasks is a defining factor and heavily conditions agent performance in robotics tasks. In this unprecedented large-scale study, we ran 966 navigation episodes of static point goal navigation in a real-world building for 24km and asked which components really matter for the computer vision aspects of robotics: we evaluate state-of-the art visual encoders in realistic conditions. We explore the usefulness of heterogeneous multi-teacher distillation leading to encoders with multiple different and complementary skills. We investigate how much information from these encoders is necessary for robotics by bottlenecking them in a principled and spatially useful way and we show that this leads to the emergence of interpretable features linked to affordances. We also argue that training policies on RGB data alone does not lead to an optimal usage of visual features and show this by finetuning policies pre-trained on privileged information. All in all, we paint a more complete picture of what aspects of computer vision are relevant for real-world navigation.

</details>


### [318] [A UAV-Mounted Sensor Network for Close-Range Inspection of Wind Turbine Rotor Blades](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21220)
*Jost Wittmann,Ahmed Abdullahi Hassan,Nils Kömpe,Andreas Nüchter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无人机搭载的多模态传感器系统，结合RGB相机、热红外相机和3D扫描仪，用于海上风力发电机叶片的近距离检测，实现几何、颜色和热数据的空间叠加，初步实验验证了多传感器同步采集和点云重建的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无人机检测方法仅能识别表面异常，缺陷分类仍依赖人工且易出错；海上风机叶片位置偏远、结构巨大，现有传感器系统难以满足多模态数据融合需求。

Method: 设计无人机搭载的多模态传感器网络，包含工业RGB相机、被动热红外相机和自主开发的3D扫描仪；所有传感器联合标定到统一坐标系，实现几何、颜色和热数据的空间叠加；系统针对近距操作优化，解决平台运动、大视场和毫米级精度三个核心挑战。

Result: 实验室初步结果显示了多传感器同步采集能力和初始点云重建效果，为后续空中检测试验奠定了基础。

Conclusion: 该多模态传感器系统有望提升海上风机叶片缺陷分类的自动化水平，但还需通过实际飞行试验验证其现场性能。

Abstract: Inspection of offshore wind turbine rotor blades is critical for predictive maintenance to maximise efficiency and extend operational lifetime. However, it remains a challenging task due to remote locations, large structural dimensions, and the limitations of current UAV-compatible sensor systems. While existing approaches can detect certain types of surface anomalies, reliable classification of defect types often remains a manual and error-prone process.
  This paper presents the design of a UAV-mounted multimodal sensor network combining an industrial RGB camera, a passive thermal infrared camera, and an in-house developed 3D scanner. All sensors are co-calibrated into a common coordinate frame, enabling spatial superimposition of geometric, colour, and thermal data. The system is designed to operate at close range, addressing three fundamental sensing challenges: platform motion, large field of view, and millimetre-level measurement accuracy. Preliminary laboratory results demonstrate synchronised multi-sensor acquisition and initial point cloud reconstructions, forming the basis for future airborne inspection trials.

</details>


### [319] [FleetAgent: Teleoperation Assistant for Autonomous Fleets via Vectorized V2N Messages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21222)
*Juntong Peng,Qi Chen,Deyuan Qu,Takayuki Shimizu,Yaobin Chen,Ziran Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出FleetAgent，一种基于多模态大语言模型的云托管助手，通过压缩的矢量V2N消息替代原始传感器数据，实现大规模自动驾驶车队的远程监控与操作员优先级排序，显著降低上行链路负载和计算成本，同时提升干预评估性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模自动驾驶车队依赖远程操作处理罕见故障，但直接传输原始传感器数据成本高昂，且远程操作员同时监控的车辆数量有限。现有方法在带宽、效率和可扩展性方面存在瓶颈。

Method: 提出FleetAgent框架，包含：(1) VecFormer——矢量到嵌入的接口，通过可微top-K上下文选择控制序列长度和KV-cache增长；(2) 结构化V2N消息（地图元素、检测对象、自车规划路径）；(3) 结构化自然语言响应（叙述、解释、评估）及干预紧急度评分；(4) VecEval数据集（基于nuScenes，含人工/合成不完美计划及人工验证标签）。

Result: 与原始图像相比，上行链路负载降低625倍；KV-cache内存比原始文本描述降低16.54倍；在VecEval上，Lingo-Judge评分提升16.8%，干预失败率降低19.9%。

Conclusion: FleetAgent能够利用紧凑的结构化V2N消息实现高效、可解释的自动驾驶车队远程监控，在带宽、计算和性能方面均优于传统方法。

Abstract: Large-scale autonomous fleets rely on teleoperation to resolve rare failures, yet streaming raw sensor data from many vehicles is costly, and remote operators can only monitor a limited number of vehicles at a time. We introduce FleetAgent, a cloud-hosted multimodal large language model (MLLM) assistant that consumes compact vectorized vehicle-to-network (V2N) messages, such as map elements, detected objects, and the ego planned path. It provides a structured natural-language response (including narration, explanation, and evaluation of the plan and scene), along with an intervention urgency score for operator prioritization. To make structured messages compatible with token-based MLLMs, we propose VecFormer, a vector-to-embedding interface with differentiable top-K context selection that bounds context length and GPU KV-cache growth, enabling more efficient batch processing, which is important under the context of cloud-hosted large-scale fleet management. We also construct VecEval, a nuScenes-derived dataset with paired human and synthetic imperfect plans and human-verified language labels, to facilitate the training and evaluation of our proposed system. Our proposed system can reduce uplink payload by up to 625 times compared with raw images and reduce KV-cache memory by 16.54 times compared with original text descriptions. On VecEval, FleetAgent improves Lingo-Judge score by 16.8% and reduces intervention failure rate by 19.9%, compared with Qwen2.5-VL-7B using language descriptions. These results demonstrate that FleetAgent can utilize compact structured V2N messaging to enable efficient, explainable teleoperation monitoring for autonomous fleets.

</details>


### [320] [Ultra-Fusion: A Resilient Tightly-Coupled Multi-Sensor Fusion SLAM Framework under Sensor Degradation and Spatiotemporal Perturbation for Intelligent Transportation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21223)
*Yihong Tian,Junjie Zhang,Liuyang Li,Deteng Zhang,Yunfei Zuo,Jie Yin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Ultra-Fusion，一个基于统一滑动窗口估计器的紧耦合多传感器定位框架，通过可观测性感知初始化、因子级可靠性调度和在线LiDAR-IMU时空标定，在传感器退化（光照不足、LiDAR退化、车轮打滑、GNSS中断）和标定误差下实现鲁棒定位，并在多种平台（轮式、足式、空中）上验证了竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有紧耦合多传感器融合方法在理想条件下精度尚可，但在实际部署中易受传感器退化（光照不足、LiDAR退化、车轮打滑、GNSS中断）以及时空标定误差的影响，导致城市峡谷、隧道、高速走廊等场景下定位漂移，影响路径跟踪和地图对齐。

Method: 提出Ultra-Fusion框架，基于统一滑动窗口估计器，将异步测量按时间戳排序并转换为优化窗口内的可选因子，支持WIO/VIO/LIO/LVIO四种模式及可选轮式和GNSS增强。采用可观测性感知初始化选择引导模式，因子级可靠性调度门控退化测量，并实现在线LiDAR-IMU时空标定以优化时间偏移和旋转外参。

Result: 在M3DGR、M2DGR-Plus、KAIST、GrandTour、MARS-LVIG等基准上评估60余种开源SLAM系统，在轮式、足式、空中平台上，面对长时间高速运行、传感器退化和标定扰动场景下均展现出竞争性精度。

Conclusion: Ultra-Fusion提升了道路级自主驾驶、校园和仓库移动以及低空航空巡检的定位可用性，论文接受后将开源代码和数据集以惠及工业与学术界。

Abstract: Reliable localization is essential for intelligent transportation systems (ITS), including autonomous vehicles, quadruped last-mile carriers, and infrastructure-inspection unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Although tightly-coupled multi-sensor fusion improves accuracy in favorable conditions, deployed systems remain vulnerable to sensor degradation -- poor illumination, LiDAR degeneracy, wheel slippage, and GNSS outage -- and to spatiotemporal calibration errors. These failures are common in urban canyons, tunnels, and high-speed corridors, where localization drift can degrade route tracking, tunnel passage continuity, and local map alignment. This paper presents Ultra-Fusion, a tightly-coupled multi-sensor localization framework based on a unified sliding-window estimator. Asynchronous measurements are timestamp-ordered and converted into optional factors within one optimization window, supporting WIO, VIO, LIO, and LVIO with optional wheel and GNSS augmentation. Observability-aware initialization selects the bootstrap mode, factor-wise reliability scheduling gates degraded measurements, and online LiDAR--IMU spatiotemporal calibration refines temporal offsets and rotational extrinsics during operation. We extend the M3DGR benchmark with simulation trajectories and evaluate more than 60 open-source SLAM systems on M3DGR, M2DGR-Plus, KAIST, GrandTour, and MARS-LVIG. The results show competitive accuracy across wheeled, legged, and aerial platforms under long-duration and high-speed operation, degradation, and calibration perturbation, improving localization availability for road-level autonomy, campus and warehouse mobility, and low-altitude aerial inspection. To benefit the industrial and academic community, we will release source code and datasets upon paper acceptance.

</details>


### [321] [A Human-Inspired Thumb-Index Robotic Hand with Strain Gauges Embedded in Soft Joints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21245)
*Jonas Papenbrock,Shubhan Patni,Tomaso Lisini Baldi,Michele Guerri,Elia Landi,Ada Fort,Matej Hoffmann*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了STIR机械手——一种轻量、低成本的两指机械手，通过欠驱动肌腱设计与嵌入软关节的应变传感器，实现了被动抓取适应与内外感知，在物体分类任务中达到高精度，无需额外指尖触觉或视觉系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受人类手部抓取适应依赖于物理结构与生物反馈协同作用的启发，旨在开发一种轻量、低成本且具备感知能力的机器人手，克服传统工业夹爪和机器人手在敏感性和安全性方面的局限。

Method: 设计了不对称拇指-食指配置的STIR手，采用欠驱动肌腱驱动机构，将柔性应变计嵌入硅胶封装的软关节中，实现被动抓取适应、本体感知和外感知。通过无监督分析、物体分类任务和消融研究进行评估。

Result: 在20种不同物体的抓取数据集中，物体尺寸、形状和材料刚度的分类准确率很高。消融研究验证了软关节传感器的贡献。与传统设备对比验证了STIR手的有效性。

Conclusion: 传感化的柔性关节可显著提高整体灵敏度和抓取安全性，且无需额外的指尖触觉元件或外部视觉系统，为低成本、高感知能力的机器人手设计提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Human hand grasp adaptation depends mainly on the synergy between physical structure and biological feedback. Inspired by this biomechanical principle, the Safe Thumb-Index Robotic (STIR) Hand was developed as a minimal, lightweight, and low-cost two-digit prototype featuring an asymmetric thumb-index configuration. By pairing an underactuated, tendon-driven mechanical design with flexible strain gauges embedded into silicone-encapsulated soft joints, the system achieves passive grasp adaptation while establishing both internal proprioception and external perception. Unsupervised analysis was carried out on a dataset of the STIR hand grasping 20 different objects, along with an object classification task and an ablation study to highlight the contribution of the soft joint sensors. The object classification task discriminated object size, shape, and material stiffness with a high classification accuracy. In contrast to traditional industrial grippers and robotic hands, the STIR Hand demonstrates that sensorized compliant joints significantly improve overall sensitivity and ensure safe grasping, while remaining independent of additional fingertip tactile elements or external vision systems. Finally, a comparison to similar devices grasping identical objects validates the utility of the STIR Hand.

</details>


### [322] [Spectral GS-SLAM: Observability-Aware, Degeneracy-Robust Tracking for Real-Time 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21258)
*Edward Beng Wai Tan,Siew-Kei Lam,Dongshuo Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Spectral GS-SLAM，通过将ICP与互补的特征匹配约束相结合，并引入高斯感知的平面性加权机制，在结构缺失和纹理缺失场景中实现鲁棒的实时跟踪（40.14 FPS）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS-SLAM系统在纹理缺失环境中特征匹配易失败，在结构缺失或几何退化场景中ICP跟踪因优化病态而失效，亟需一种能同时应对两类退化场景的鲁棒跟踪框架。

Method: 1) 将ICP与互补的特征匹配约束集成，在退化场景中自适应补偿欠约束方向；2) 引入高斯感知的平面性加权机制，利用3D高斯协方差结构表征场景几何并指导信息融合。

Result: 在挑战性TUM RGB-D序列上达到40.14 FPS的实时性能，在结构缺失和纹理缺失环境中均保持一致跟踪，退化场景中轨迹完整性得到保持，非退化条件下性能同样具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 所提方法通过自适应退化补偿和高斯感知加权机制，在不干扰共享高斯地图表示的前提下，实现了对结构缺失和纹理缺失场景的鲁棒实时SLAM跟踪。

Abstract: Recent 3DGS-SLAM systems enable real-time operation by leveraging conventional feature matching or ICP-based tracking, thereby avoiding the heavy dense photometric optimization used in earlier approaches. However, feature matching remains prone to failure in textureless environments, while ICP-based tracking struggles in structureless or geometrically degenerate scenes due to ill-conditioned optimization. To address this issue, we propose Spectral GS-SLAM, an efficient yet robust tracking framework that integrates ICP with complementary feature-based constraints. Our method mitigates numerical instability by adaptively compensating under-constrained directions in degenerate scenarios, without interfering with the shared Gaussian representation used for mapping. We further introduce a Gaussian-aware planarity weighting mechanism that exploits the intrinsic covariance structure of 3D Gaussians to characterize scene geometry and guide information fusion. Extensive evaluations on challenging TUM RGB-D sequences demonstrate that Spectral GS-SLAM achieves real-time performance (40.14 FPS) while maintaining consistent tracking in both structureless and featureless environments. The proposed method preserves trajectory integrity in degenerate scenes while maintaining competitive performance in non-adverse conditions.

</details>


### [323] [RogueRover: Autonomous Rogue Device Localization for Incident Response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21264)
*Priyanka Prakash Surve,Asaf Shabtai,Yuval Elovici*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出RogueRover系统，利用单台四足机器人自主巡逻，通过标准WiFi接口采集带空间标签的RSSI数据，无需RF指纹、预装传感器或现场校准，即可在零配置约束下检测和定位未授权无线设备。在11次巡逻实验中，中位定位误差为1.62米。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理定位未授权无线设备（如恶意AP）是网络安全的关键瓶颈。现有方法依赖密集传感基础设施、现场RF指纹或人工巡检，响应速度慢、成本高，亟需一种无需额外基础设施的自主定位方案。

Method: RogueRover系统：采用四足机器人自主巡逻，利用标准802.11接口采集带空间标签的RSSI测量值，离线使用加权质心估计器或参数化路径损耗模型进行设备定位，无需RF指纹或现场校准。

Result: 11次真实室内环境巡逻，6个恶意设备，62次AP-巡逻会话：中位单次定位误差1.62米；多次聚合后5/6设备误差<1米；盲测中正确识别73个BSSID中的恶意设备，定位误差0.34米和1.84米。加权质心法效果优于或等于参数化模型。

Conclusion: 结果表明，零基础设施、零配置的自主无线设备定位是可行的，机器人自主巡逻的测量覆盖范围是定位精度的主要决定因素，该系统可实现网络物理环境中的快速物理安全响应。

Abstract: Physically localizing unauthorized wireless devices remains a critical bottleneck in cyber-physical security operations, where rogue access points can provide entry points for lateral movement and persistent compromise. While such devices can often be detected through network-side mechanisms, determining their physical location typically requires dense sensing infrastructure, site-specific RF fingerprinting, or manual inspection, limiting timely incident response.
